model_description: Learned Horner ensemble with an 85,021-parameter width-9 Tier-2 TCN and an 85,556-parameter shared-context width-16 Tier-3 TCN. Each scans a sanctioned pairwise-reduced operand through a learned hard recurrent state and emits one base-p digit. Inputs above the learned width receive a deterministic zero fallback.
training_description: The Tier-2 model was trained for 2,400 AdamW steps on synthetic Horner transitions through modulus 257. The Tier-3 model was initialized by learned width transfer and trained for 2,400 steps with quotient-2 and reduction-boundary hard mining. It passed a frozen five-seed official-generator Tier-3 gate at 499/500 exact. Checked public Tier-3 answers were not used for training or model selection. Seed 20260712.
